common.design_status: Proposed implementable documentation, not deployed software or an authority grant
common.authority: Every command authenticates actor and tenant from trusted runtime context; validates grant/purpose/resource, expected version, policy version and exact input hashes. Agents can request only explicitly permitted task operations; human commands remain human-only.
common.commit_semantics: Mutating commands validate and append state/event/receipt with optimistic concurrency and transactional outbox where applicable. Same operation key and same intent hash returns prior receipt; same key/different hash rejects conflict. An HTTP/network response alone is not business completion.
common.no_silent_migration: Published contract/policy/rule versions are immutable. In-flight cases pin versions. Migration requires an explicit reviewed mapping, preconditions, affected-approval analysis and rollback/forward-recovery plan; the model cannot migrate itself.
common.intent_hashing: Canonical semantic-intent hash uses tenant, contract/action/version, subject identity, business payload and input content versions, destination and purpose. It excludes transport attempt ID, request timestamp and retry counter. Transport request hash additionally records those fields. Validate before reserving a business operation: a failed guard returns an attempt receipt but does not permanently consume the key. Identical unchanged intent may revalidate with fresh expected version/grant after a stale-state failure; changed semantic payload must use a new operation key. Accepted/committed operations return their durable receipt rather than executing again.
common.unknowns: Unspecified business permission, rule or source identity fails closed for the dependent action; independent permitted evidence gathering may continue.
common.state_model: Listed success transitions are representative explicit commands; rejected guards leave state unchanged with a failure receipt. Unknown/permanent failures use the stated failure paths. Query commands do not mutate business state except through a separately validated reconciliation transition.

contracts.name: Schedules and deadlines

contracts.status: Proposed technical execution contract; source rules and required owner configuration are separately bound

transitions.guard: All source-required timing parameters resolved; valid timezone/calendar; due_at recomputed, not trusted from model
Expected version matches; new version created atomically; historical due date retained
Authoritative clock >= due_at and occurrence not cancelled/fired; acquire fenced lease
Valid fencing token; transaction records occurrence and outbox intent once
CAS version check; already committed delivery is not recalled
Missing occurrence is due; reconcile ledger before replay; unchanged fired occurrence stays fired
Only recurring rule; previous occurrence immutable; next due computed from anchored calendar, not last processing time; unique next occurrence key. One-shot schedules remain fired.
Due time passed but capacity unavailable; persist overdue visibility, never silently discard.
Expired lease and no committed fire receipt; increment fence and recheck current schedule version. If committed, retain fired state and return existing receipt.
Cancel parent future recurrence only; immutable prior fired occurrence/delivery retained. Return cancellation receipt referencing parent.

invariants: Store UTC instants plus source timezone/calendar/rule version; preserve event time and computation time separately.
Business days, working hours, deadline inclusivity and pause rules are explicit configuration, never inferred from server locale.
A due-event is a request to evaluate current workflow prerequisites, not permission to advance business state.
Unique tenant+schedule version+occurrence key prevents duplicate firing. Revision versus fire is serialized; a committed earlier reminder remains auditable.
Downtime recovery emits one catch-up control event per missed occurrence, not a burst of external messages; disposition records every missed recurrence.
A received completion and deadline crossing use one serialized state check. Late evidence does not erase the fact that a deadline was missed.

State is occurrence-scoped. The parent schedule definition has active/cancelled/superseded status; fired occurrence evidence is never overwritten by advancing recurrence. schedule.advance_recurrence atomically creates the next occurrence and returns its armed state, while the prior occurrence remains fired.
calendar_ref is required semantically only for working-calendar calculations or calendar-based recurrence; elapsed24h timing uses exact elapsed seconds and does not wait for a holiday calendar.
Claim expires after the configured lease; stale fencing tokens cannot fire after cancellation/revision/reclaim.
technical_defaults: Proposed storage default UTC; display uses configured business timezone. No default business timezone, holiday calendar or reminder lead time.
Scheduler scan interval 60 seconds is a proposed operational target, not a business SLA. Due conditions use actual timestamps, not scan counts.
Catch-up work enters a bounded queue. External reminder delivery is not included in schedule.fire; a separately authorized notification route is required.
owner_configuration: Exact IANA timezone, calendar and start/stop/pause conditions for each source deadline.
For stated ranges such as 1–2 working days, preserve range until an authorized selection rule exists; do not silently choose 2.
Confirmed reminder recipient/action template; notification authority independent of timer creation.

Source sequence is used only where the source guarantees it; otherwise version/hash checks and authoritative reconciliation resolve ordering.

Canonical event state is separate from each delivery-attempt disposition. Duplicate or conflicting receipt does not overwrite applied canonical state.

Quarantine records typed reasons: authentication_failed/schema_invalid/identity_ambiguous/hash_conflict/out_of_order. Release requires every original failure resolved and all ingress validations repeated.

Initial receive stores received state and ingress receipt before acknowledgement. Source reconciliation writes observed missing events via event.receive and advances checkpoint atomically only through a contiguous durably stored source position; gaps retain prior checkpoint.

Correcting events have their own identity and normal validation/correlation/application; applying one links supersedes_event_id to the old canonical event and marks its derived readiness stale. Original bytes/events remain immutable.
technical_defaults: Proposed default: quarantine ambiguous identities and unknown event schemas, preserve metadata and restricted payload, continue unrelated cases.
No polling interval or connector access is assumed. Reconciliation checkpoints advance only after durably storing all accepted items.
owner_configuration: Actual source producer IDs, supported webhook/poll/export route, subject keys and source sequencing guarantees.
Authorized correction and approval-invalidation policy for business records.

One atomic command creates exactly one successor batch keyed by predecessor+correction operation; returns prior successor on duplicate. Prior results remain immutable; required correction authority/rules present.

invariants: Represent quantities as signed decimal strings with currency/unit/scale, entity, account/BU, period and precision metadata. Binary floating point is not the monetary oracle.
No implicit cross-currency sum, sign inversion or thousand scaling. Transformations are named versioned rules with input/output dimensions.
Value status is present/missing/not_applicable/error; present zero remains a value. Null/error never becomes zero by default.

F23 intended company/BU tie-out is exact equality to management accounts, per FIN P0111. Comparison occurs only after approved mappings and unit/precision normalization; do not invent a nonzero tolerance.
F25 narrated annual budget/12×elapsed months is recorded as known method; applicability, fiscal periods and exact workbook must be confirmed, not formula re-invented.
F19 headcount allocation is limited to the described other-staff pool. Shared-service, executive and OPEX rules remain distinct, not inferred from it.
F12 split/reclassification preserves original totals unless explicitly additive treatment is established. No duplicate revenue from manual detail.
Correction dependency graph identifies affected monthly/YTD/report outputs; historical restatement and released-report treatment require actual policy.
Cash forecasts are partial coverage by source description; reconciliation must not assert all receivables were included.

Cancellation atomically stops dispatch and marks every unstarted item cancelled; completed results remain attached. Cancelled batch cannot calculate more items; a separately authorized successor is required.
Batch corrections are atomic successor creation, not a two-command reuse of batch.correct. Readiness invalidation and successor linkage commit together with the outbox.

After item commit, project aggregate in this order: sticky cancellation→cancelled; any blocked/failed/error item→partially_completed; all required items valid→completed; otherwise remaining eligible items→running. Reconciled is a later explicit control-total success. These mutually exclusive inventory conditions govern calculate_item transitions.
technical_defaults: Proposed canonical decimal representation, no implicit rounding; numeric_policy must name scale, rounding mode/stage and residual disposition before affected result can be finalized.
Pure calculation retry uses same rule+input hashes+item key and returns prior result; no financial write is part of calculate_item.
Per-item execution permits safe recomputation of affected items, but dependent aggregates wait for complete declared coverage.
owner_configuration: Native account/BU/employee maps, exact rates/private ratios, currency/sign/scale, fiscal calendar and independently approved expected examples.
Rounding/residual method, permitted non-F23 tolerances, correction/restatement treatment and missing-match policy.
F07 complete depreciation schedule; full F09/F39 dependency rules and opening balance; source-bound observed cells are not full production oracles.

Lease expiry does not prove a remote effect failed. Reclaim reads durable effect intent before deciding whether replay is safe.
Fencing token must be enforced at local commits and passed to adapters where supported; unsupported downstream fencing requires idempotency/reconciliation.
No worker holds database locks or live leases while waiting on a human or external job. Persist wait state/correlation then release capacity.
Ordering is per declared subject/partition where needed, not global. Cross-partition dependencies use workflow state, not queue arrival order.
Priority and quotas cannot bypass policy/approval. No automatic dropping of financial tasks during overload.
Infrastructure dead-letter handling never changes B06 business queue or grants queue-add authority.
queue.fail validates current lease/fencing token for worker updates; reconciler uses queue.reclaim_expired or queue.reconcile_outcome, never impersonates worker failure.

queue.redrive is identical semantic-intent retry only after remediation that leaves payload unchanged. Corrected payload creates a new task/version/operation key through workflow validation; prior failed item retains successor link.
On cancellation while a worker runs, current worker reports any committed effect before cancellation completion. No report/expired lease with possible effect becomes outcome_unknown, not cancelled.
Cancellation tombstone survives lease expiry, redrive, reconciliation and callback. Any replay/resume checks it. Completed effects remain recorded; cancellation never fabricates reversal.
technical_defaults: Proposed operational defaults:60s lease,20s heartbeat,5 safe attempts; backoff min(60s,2^(attempt-1)s) plus uniform0–1s jitter. Values versioned and tunable without changing business deadlines.
Proposed per-tenant/per-adapter concurrency quotas must be configured before activation; no unbounded fanout. Backpressure rejects/defer-enqueues with explicit receipt, never silent loss.
Policy/validation failures do not retry unchanged; unknown effects park for X03/X07 reconciliation; terminal items require authorized redrive.
owner_configuration: Actual connector rate/concurrency limits and operational capacity targets, set by implementation operators.
Separate B06/B07 financial queue contract, states, authority and evidence from its owning team; generic runtime cannot supply them.
